business_problem: Deep Potential needed infrastructure for AI-for-science workloads whose compute demand could spike to hundreds of thousands of cores and whose data path had to support heterogeneous compute pools, hot small files, rapid loading, and quota management. Its Bohrium and Hermite platforms needed storage and scheduling patterns that could keep scientific AI jobs fast and economical even under extreme elasticity.
solution_summary: Deep Potential and Alibaba Cloud designed a layered data infrastructure for AI-driven scientific computing and drug design. Near the compute tier, Fluid turns high-speed media inside the cluster into a logical cache layer so model files and data can be loaded faster and images can be pulled quickly enough to launch Pods in seconds. Above that, a general-purpose NAS layer provides shared read or write acceleration for many clusters and helps absorb hotspots caused by huge numbers of small files. For long-term retention, multi-tier OSS stores model files, checkpoints, and datasets economically while still supporting cross-region loading through Alibaba Cloud's global network. Those layers back Deep Potential's Bohrium research cloud and Hermite drug-design platform, allowing the company to pool data across heterogeneous compute, schedule large elastic jobs, and move from experiment-heavy workflows toward model-driven scientific discovery.

solution_components.name: Fluid
solution_components.role: Creates the near-compute logical cache layer that speeds data access and image pulls for scientific AI jobs.

solution_components.name: NAS
solution_components.role: Provides shared accelerated storage for many clusters and mitigates hot-small-file performance issues.

solution_components.name: Object Storage Service (OSS)
solution_components.role: Stores model files, checkpoints, and datasets as the long-term low-cost data layer.

solution_components.name: Container Service for Kubernetes (ACK)
solution_components.role: Runs containerized AI-for-science workloads that consume the layered storage design.

solution_components.name: Container Compute Service (ACS)
solution_components.role: Adds elastic container compute capacity for scientific workloads that need rapid scale-out.

solution_components.name: Elastic Compute Service (ECS)
solution_components.role: Provides additional compute resources that work with the broader AI-for-science infrastructure.

data_flow: Scientific datasets, model files, and checkpoints are held in OSS, accelerated into NAS for multi-cluster sharing, and cached close to compute by Fluid when jobs are launched on ACK, ACS, and ECS. Those layers feed Bohrium and Hermite workflows so large-scale simulation, training, and drug-design tasks can load data quickly and schedule elastic compute resources efficiently.
business_outcome: Alibaba Cloud helped Deep Potential turn AI-for-science infrastructure into a production system for industrial and biomedical R&D. The platform can handle hundreds of thousands of cores at peak, support cross-discipline data pooling, and shorten drug-screening and optimization cycles from years to months or even weeks while keeping storage and compute spending under tighter control.

architecture_clues: The infrastructure deliberately splits storage into near-compute cache, shared acceleration, and long-term archival layers.
Pod startup speed is treated as a scientific productivity bottleneck, so image caching is part of the data design.
The same storage design supports both AI model artifacts and domain datasets such as checkpoints and scientific corpora.
Elastic compute and data pooling are designed for heterogeneous AI-for-science workloads rather than one fixed model pipeline.
